infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your position is shown to dispatch while you are on shift so they can plan routes and give customers accurate ETAs.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Background location keeps your route measured while the app is in your pocket during a shift. Tracking stops when you end your shift.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera captures proof of delivery photos and fuel receipts.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Background location keeps your route measured during a shift and stops when you end it.
